description: Search 1,000+ vetted AI use cases by keyword, industry, or business workflow (e.g. 'invoice', 'dental', 'customer support'). Use when someone asks how AI can help their business, wants AI ideas for an industry, or looks for automation opportunities. Also use it to find the slug before get_agent_playbook or run_agent. Returns titles, summaries, and links. Public: no sign-in.

industry.description: Optional area or sub-industry slug that limits the search, such as accounting, hvac, or home-trade/hvac.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 20.

query.description: Words to match. Example: invoice, patient intake, HVAC dispatch.

name: search_use_cases
title: Search AI Use Cases
